verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no Cline documentation of a training opt-out, a data-usage policy, or a zero-retention commitment for code and prompts. BYOK, local models via Ollama/LM Studio, and self-hosting are adjacent ways to route data away from Cline's provider, but they are user-side arrangements, not a documented opt-out control. So no credit is given.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can opt out of having my code and prompts used for AI model training
